entities.name: Dawid Wdowiński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dawid (David) Wdowiński was a psychiatrist and doctor of neurology in the Second Polish Republic. After the 1939 invasion of Poland by Nazi Germany, he became a political leader of the Jewish resistance organization called Żydowski Związek Wojskowy active before and during the Warsaw Ghetto uprising.
